Rede's fourth beta is here so the third can install it. If you have 0.1.0-beta.3, Settings › About offers this one: Download, then Restart to Update. Nothing else changes.

### Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Rede-0.1.0-beta.4-macos-universal.dmg` (or `.zip`) | macOS 11 or later, Apple silicon and Intel |
| `Rede-0.1.0-beta.4-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux on Intel/AMD, glibc 2.39 or newer |
| `Rede-0.1.0-beta.4-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Linux on ARM64, glibc 2.39 or newer |

The `.minisig` files are signatures Rede checks before installing an update. [Install and sign-in instructions](https://github.com/Solidsilver/ond/blob/rede-v0.1.0-beta.4/docs/rede/README.md).

### Please report

If the update doesn't install, Settings › About says why. Please report it with your OS, how you installed Rede, and that message.

The beta limits are the same as [0.1.0-beta.3](https://github.com/Solidsilver/ond/releases/tag/rede-v0.1.0-beta.3)'s.
